content.name: Nikola Petrović
content.title: Store Manager (Filialleiter)
content.summary: Store manager with 19 years in German retail, from an IHK apprenticeship to running a 6,000 sqm furniture and home store in Köln with 95 employees and €28m in sales. Geprüfter Handelsfachwirt (IHK) with a track record of cooperative work with the works council and a store that has been the company's most profitable for three years.

experience.title: Store Manager (Filialleiter)
bullets: Run a 6,000 sqm furniture and home store with €28m annual sales, 95 employees, seven department heads and a warehouse with delivery team.
Raised EBIT margin from 4.8% to 7.1% through a new kitchen planning studio, tighter delivery routes and lower credit-note rates.
Negotiated a shift model for Saturday and late openings with the works council that cut overtime by 2,900 hours a year.
Brought customer complaint resolution time down from 11 to four working days by giving department heads authority for goodwill decisions up to €500.
Developed three trainees into department heads and run the store's apprenticeship programme with 12 Auszubildende.

experience.title: Store Manager (Filialleiter)
bullets: Managed a two-floor sports store with €9.5m sales and 38 employees in a Köln city-centre shopping street.
Grew sales by 21% over four years by adding a running lab and partnering with local clubs for team kit orders.
Introduced click-and-reserve for the online shop, which accounted for 15% of store sales by 2019.
Kept inventory differences below 0.5% of sales at every annual stocktake.

experience.title: Department Manager (Abteilungsleiter)
bullets: Led the household goods and electronics department with €4.2m sales and 16 staff.
Reorganised the department layout around customer journeys, increasing sales per square metre by 13%.
Planned staffing for Christmas and seasonal sales events, including temporary staff onboarding.

experience.title: Sales Associate (Verkäufer)
bullets: Advised customers on televisions, computers and home audio, regularly among the top three sellers in the store.
Took over ordering for the computer accessories range after one year.
Trained new apprentices on product knowledge and checkout processes.
